QuestInfo.name: [Beasts of Fury] Mr. Do Slips Up
QuestInfo.0: Mr. Do of Mu Lung has a favor to ask of you.
QuestInfo.1: Mr. Do says the cold medicine Grizzly took made him lose his mind. He wants you to check on him.
QuestInfo.2: Mr. Do says the cold medicine's ingredients got switched, and suspects a thief came last night.
